content.short: Birdeye gives traders real-time token, wallet, and market data with charts, alerts, and crosschain DeFi coverage.
content.description: Birdeye is a live crypto market intelligence platform used to track token prices, liquidity, trades, wallet activity, and onchain momentum across supported networks. Its products combine charting, watchlists, portfolio views, alerts, and token discovery tools that help users react to fast moving markets. For Mantle, Birdeye serves as a practical monitoring layer for ecosystem tokens and pools, while developers and analysts can also rely on its data products to follow activity and surface market signals with less manual research.
content.meta: Birdeye delivers real-time token and wallet analytics for Mantle market activity.
